csv_scope_of_work: The Louisiana Dept of Transportation & Development , may be seeking a consultant for Coordinated Use of Resources for Recreation, Economy, Navigation and Transportation (Current) Authority Board Master Plan Development. Develop a master plan and an annual plan for protecting, conserving, enhancing, and developing the area outside the coastal area through the construction and management of integrated projects and programs, including privately funded projects or plans, and addressing those activities that significantly affect such projects, all consistent with the legislative intent (LA R.S. 38 2354 and other related).
